dossier.headline: IT heavyweights lead Monday's decline
dossier.summary: After rallying in early October on TCS's results, IT is now the market's main drag. On Monday Nov 9, HCLTech, Tech Mahindra, Infosys and TCS were the top four Sensex losers, with HCLTech down about 1.9–2.1% and Infosys about 1.5%, and Nifty IT the weakest sector.
why_it_matters: IT is a heavy weight in the Nifty and Sensex, so its selling pulls the benchmarks lower
The selling follows a global tech selloff last week
